description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Scourge of Valkas.
When the Scourge of Valkas tokens enter, each Scourge of Valkas triggers five times.
Resolve all Scourge of Valkas triggers, dealing at least 180 damage divided among a maximum of 30 targets.
